name: Magic Patterns
description_en:
Magic Patterns is an AI interface design and frontend prototyping platform for product teams. Users describe screens and flows, supply screenshots or design-system context, refine generated interfaces and export or hand off code. It targets interactive product exploration rather than general-purpose logo, print or photo editing.

The main operating unit is a workspace: its plan, seats and credits determine access and cost. Manual editing/export and AI generation have different billing rules. Free-plan confidentiality, attribution and training exceptions are particularly important when deciding whether to upload a private product brief.
description_zh:
Magic Patterns 是面向产品团队的 AI 界面设计及前端原型平台。用户描述页面和流程，提供截图或设计系统上下文，修改生成界面，再导出或交接代码。它主要用于交互产品探索，并非通用标志、印刷或照片编辑。

主要运营单位是工作区，其方案、席位和点数决定权益与费用。手动编辑/导出与 AI 生成的收费规则不同。上传私有产品需求前尤其应注意免费方案在保密、署名及训练方面的例外。

sections.title_en: Prototype a product flow with real design context
sections.title_zh: 用真实设计上下文建立产品流程原型
sections.en:
The [introduction](https://www.magicpatterns.com/docs/documentation/get-started/introduction) positions Magic Patterns for product managers, designers, engineers and customer-facing teams. A useful task is exploring a checkout screen or account settings flow before engineering implementation: describe the target users and states, attach a screenshot or specification and supply reusable components/styles. The result is a frontend artifact to inspect and iterate.

Editorial boundary: a convincing button or data table is not proof of payment processing, permissions, real persistence or a working backend. The prompting guide explicitly calls the platform frontend-only. Treat integrations, production security and business behavior as separate engineering work. Do not interpret the product-team positioning as documented suitability for every print or graphic design task in this catalog category.
sections.zh:
[入门页](https://www.magicpatterns.com/docs/documentation/get-started/introduction)面向产品经理、设计师、工程师及客户沟通团队。一个有用任务是在工程实现前探索结账页面或账户设置流程：描述用户与状态，附截图或规格，提供可复用组件/样式，再检查和迭代前端产物。

编辑边界：看似可用的按钮或数据表不证明具备支付、权限、真实持久化或后端。提示指南明确称平台仅前端；集成、生产安全及业务行为仍需独立工程实现。不能因其属于产品团队工具，就认为适合本目录中的全部印刷或图形设计任务。

sections.title_en: Select the object, make a bounded change, inspect the state
sections.title_zh: 选中对象、局部修改并检查状态
sections.en:
The [prompting guide](https://www.magicpatterns.com/docs/documentation/editor/how-to-prompt) says to toggle Select Mode in the chat’s lower-left corner, click an element and use the Visual Edit panel. Selection adds element context to the chat; visual properties can also be edited manually and saved. Images and Markdown files can be attached; Markdown persists as docs/*.md with the design, so consider what private context remains attached.

For example, specify that three checkboxes should update a progress bar, rather than merely asking for “a better checklist.” Test checked/unchecked and navigation states after each change. If the result appears unchanged, /Ask can explain whether a new page was created but not linked; /Debug addresses failures. Previewing a historical artifact does not restore it. “Restore this version” creates a new latest version from that artifact. The guide recommends smaller focused updates, rollback or a fresh fork when iterations become inconsistent instead of indefinitely repeating broad prompts.
sections.zh:
[提示指南](https://www.magicpatterns.com/docs/documentation/editor/how-to-prompt)说明可在聊天左下角启用 Select Mode，点选元素进入 Visual Edit。选择会把元素上下文加入聊天，也可手动修改视觉属性后保存。可附图片和 Markdown 文件；Markdown 会以 docs/*.md 留在设计中，应考虑私有上下文会持续附着。

例如明确要求三个复选框控制进度条，而非只说“改善清单”。每次修改后检查选中/未选中及导航状态。如果看不到变化，可用 /Ask 询问是否生成了新页面却未连按钮，/Debug 用于排错。预览历史产物不等于恢复；“Restore this version”会据此建立新的最新版本。指南建议把改动拆小、回滚或另建分支对话处理不一致结果，避免无限重复宽泛提示。

sections.title_en: Export a prototype, then adapt it to production
sections.title_zh: 导出原型后再适配生产
sections.en:
The [download guide](https://www.magicpatterns.com/docs/documentation/get-started/download-code) documents Export in the upper-right corner to download a ZIP of the code. The handoff overview also links GitHub synchronization and MCP tools. These are different handoff routes; merely seeing a link does not prove any integration was connected or run.

The prompting guide recommends its Integration Skill for supported AI editors to treat output as a design specification and adapt it to existing components, tokens and conventions. That is an important distinction from pasting prototype code verbatim. Before accepting a handoff, inspect dependencies, responsive behavior, keyboard/accessibility states, empty/error/loading states and which data/services are simulated. No code archive was downloaded, built or deployed for this record, and individual generated dependency licenses remain unverified.
sections.zh:
[下载指南](https://www.magicpatterns.com/docs/documentation/get-started/download-code)说明点右上角 Export 可下载代码 ZIP。交接概览也链接 GitHub 同步和 MCP 工具；这些是不同交接方式，看到链接不证明已经连接或执行。

提示指南建议受支持 AI 编辑器使用其 Integration Skill，把输出当设计规格，适配已有组件、设计令牌和约定。这与直接粘贴原型代码不同。接收前应检查依赖、响应式、键盘/可访问性、空/错误/加载状态及哪些数据/服务只是模拟。本记录未下载、构建或部署代码包，各生成依赖的许可仍未核实。

sections.title_en: A workspace subscription plus variable generation spend
sections.title_zh: 工作区订阅加可变生成费用
sections.en:
The [billing documentation](https://www.magicpatterns.com/docs/documentation/get-started/credits-and-billing) lists Free, Starter $20/paid seat/month ($17 monthly equivalent billed annually), Business $100 ($85 annual equivalent) and Enterprise custom. Starter adds 1,000 monthly credits to the free allowance; Business adds 5,000. The free monthly allowance amount is not specified in the read table. Plans, invoices, credits and features belong to a workspace, not the account globally. All paid members in a workspace must use the same tier; 11 or more paid seats require Business/Enterprise. Free seats are separate.

Direct AI work consumes credits according to input/output complexity and model response; a fixed request count is not promised. The table’s typical 70 credits for one generation is an estimate for the named model, not a cap. The guide says manual edits, exports, sharing and Fix with AI do not consume credits, but /Ask and /Plan explicitly do. Check actual response usage. Monthly plans refresh on successful invoice payment; annual plans have a documented monthly refresh time. Unused credits roll over for one month, then expire. Cancellation expires unused/rolled-over credits at the end of the current billing period under the terms.
sections.zh:
[收费文档](https://www.magicpatterns.com/docs/documentation/get-started/credits-and-billing)列出 Free、Starter 每付费席位每月 $20（年付折合 $17）、Business $100（年付折合 $85）及 Enterprise 询价。Starter 在免费额度外加每月 1,000 点，Business 加 5,000 点；实读表格未列免费月额度具体数值。方案、账单、点数和功能属于工作区，并非全账户通用。同一工作区付费成员必须同档，达到 11 个付费席位需 Business/Enterprise，免费席位另计。

直接 AI 工作按输入/输出复杂度及模型响应消耗点数，不承诺固定请求数。表中一次生成通常 70 点是指定模型的估计，不是上限。指南表示手动编辑、导出、分享及 Fix with AI 不消耗点数，但 /Ask 和 /Plan 明确收费，应查看实际响应消耗。月付在发票成功扣款后刷新，年付有文档列出的月度刷新时间。未用点数结转一个月后到期；条款规定取消时未用及结转点数在当前账期结束失效。

sections.title_en: On-demand billing is optional and separately controlled
sections.title_zh: 按需付费需另开及控制
sections.en:
Paid workspaces can enable On-Demand Usage in settings/subscription. After included credits run out, additional credits cost $0.02 each and are billed on the next invoice. Budget limits and alert thresholds can be configured. An editor banner is an alert, not evidence that every overrun has been prevented; verify the configured limit and workspace before a long generation session. Longer conversation context also increases spend, and /Clear resets it without forking the design.

Upgrades are immediate and prorated; downgrades take effect next billing cycle. The billing FAQ says projects/code are not deleted on cancellation or downgrade and remain viewable, editable and exportable, while plan-specific features are lost. Refund requests go to support, with no unconditional refund guarantee established. Recheck checkout currency, tax, seat proration and the current workspace’s feature matrix.
sections.zh:
付费工作区可在 settings/subscription 启用 On-Demand Usage，内含点数用尽后按每点 $0.02 计费并加入下张发票，可设置预算限制和提醒阈值。编辑器横幅是提醒，不证明已阻止全部超支；长生成会话前应检查实际限额和工作区。较长对话上下文也会增加消耗，/Clear 可在不另建分支的情况下重置上下文。

升级立即生效并按比例计费，降级下个账期生效。收费 FAQ 表示取消或降级不删除项目/代码，仍可查看、编辑和导出，但会失去套餐专属功能。退款需联系支持，未建立无条件退款保证。应重查结账币种、税费、席位按比例计费及当前工作区矩阵。

sections.title_en: Free-plan content has explicit confidentiality exceptions
sections.title_zh: 免费内容有明确保密例外
sections.en:
The [terms dated April 1, 2025](https://www.magicpatterns.com/docs/documentation/legal/terms) assign the company’s rights in generated content to its creator, subject to compliance, while acknowledging similar inputs may produce similar outputs. Free-plan public artifacts may carry attribution. More significantly, the Free Plan exceptions allow public showcasing and use of user inputs/content for training and improving the service. Paid-plan content receives different contractual confidentiality and no-training treatment. Enterprise-authorized users and organization trials have defined exceptions to being treated as Free Plan users.

Therefore, inspect the active workspace and governing agreement before uploading confidential product screens or customer data; a zero-price seat is not enough to determine the applicable content regime. These are contractual statements, not an independent security audit, legal clearance of generated code or an open-source license for the platform. No upload or private-content processing was performed in this research.
sections.zh:
[2025 年 4 月 1 日条款](https://www.magicpatterns.com/docs/documentation/legal/terms)在合规条件下把公司对生成内容的权利转给创作者，同时承认相似输入可能产生相似输出。免费公开产物可能附署名。更重要的是，Free Plan 例外允许公开展示，以及使用输入/内容训练和改善服务；付费内容有不同的合同保密及不训练约束。Enterprise 授权用户及组织试用也有不按 Free Plan 处理的定义条件。

上传机密产品页面或客户数据前，应检查当前工作区及适用协议；仅看席位零价格不足以判断内容规则。这些是合同表述，不是独立安全审计、生成代码法律清权或平台开源许可。本研究未上传或处理私有内容。
